champion: Papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary
ordered_diagnoses: Papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary

salient_findings: Abdominal masses and new liver and splenic metastases
Progressive disease with hepatic and splenic lesions on CT scans
key_facts: Patient is 71 years old
Initial treatment included resection and 6 cycles of adjuvant paclitaxel/carboplatin
Patient developed liver and cecal metastases one year after initial treatment
Patient underwent multiple treatments over seven years
Patient is negative for germline mutation
Patient is positive for somatic mutation
CA125 levels increased from 145.6 to 271.7
CT scans showed progressive disease with hepatic and splenic lesions
CT scans showed metastases to right pleura
CT scans showed two abdominal masses
Foundation One sequencing of metastatic tumor tissue showed BRCA-1 mutation
Serial ctDNA analyses showed varying levels of BRCA-1 mutation
